passage:
A gray cat often slept outside the town library. No one knew where it came from. The librarian named it Page because it liked to sit near books returned by visitors.
Children loved Page, but the librarian made rules. They could not feed it inside, chase it, or wake it while it slept.
One winter morning, Page was not at the door. The librarian found it under a bench, cold and weak. A visitor who was a vet helped take it to an animal clinic.
After Page got better, a family adopted it. Children missed seeing the cat, but the librarian put a photo of Page near the door.
The library became quieter without Page, but everyone knew it now had a warmer home.
